programs.source: alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/" for text in ["Man", "Hello, World!", "", "bold", "a+b=c?"]: encoded = "" for start in range(0, len(text), 3): chunk = [ord(char) for char in text[start : start + 3]] size = len(chunk) chunk += [0] * (3 - size) value = (chunk[0] << 16) | (chunk[1] << 8) | chunk[2] symbols = "".join(alphabet[(value >> shift) & 63] for shift in [18, 12, 6, 0]) encoded += symbols[: size + 1] + "=" * (3 - size) print(f'"{text}" -> "{encoded}"')
